podcast.body: Created in 1959, this piece by Daphne Oram served as an example of how magnetic tape could be utilized to manipulate sound, showcasing her innovative experimental techniques in electronic music. "It's called Pulse Persephone from 1959, which showed how tape could be used to manipulate sound."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
